impact_comparison.rule: Multiply chance probabilities along a specified action-history path; action edges carry the same incoming factor. If current path probability times physical remaining range is at most .01 seconds, defer expansion and retain its full physical interval and probability mass. The cutoff is an ordering heuristic, not a total error bound or an estimated optimal-policy occupancy. Partial cache entries may be reopened at a larger incoming influence.
